summary: Returns TRUE when the double value pointed to by the argument is non-negative, FALSE otherwise. A minimal predicate comparing the 64-bit IEEE-754 value at offset +0 against the constant 0.0.

operations.description: Compare the double read from the argument pointer against the 0.0 boundary constant.
Return TRUE if the value is >= 0.0, otherwise return FALSE.

unresolved: The meaning of the caller context is unknown; the predicate may guard negative physical quantities (e.g. signed forces or deltas) but no caller is statically known.
